content: {"episode_id":"ep-05015","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, supporting diagnosis codes I48.91 and I48.0. Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment to accurately correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management. We request reversal of the CO-197 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 498.33."}
